ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that audits legacy enterprise codebases, maps dependencies to cloud-native microservices, and generates verified Pull Requests to refactor them.
ideas.title: Enterprise Cloud Migration Auditor & Code Refactor Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 3SVK ecosystem's focus on enterprise tracks and code review processes, highly appealing to core engineering judges looking for practical developer productivity tools.

ideas.pitch: A continuous telemetry and policy engine that inspects multi-cloud deployments in real-time, detecting idle resources and misconfigurations before they hit enterprise billing.
ideas.title: Federated Cloud Cost and Resource Governance Daemon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent pain point for cloud administrators and enterprise tech scouts evaluating candidates in the Technical Talent Dossier.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent service desk agent that ingests raw alerts, correlates them with runbooks in enterprise repositories, and executes safe self-healing scripts automatically.
ideas.title: AI-Driven ITSM Incident Triage and Auto-Remediation Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors winning ITSM automation agents that successfully reduce manual IT overhead, making it an instant hit with enterprise-focused engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: A framework where two specialized AI agents simulate zero-day attack vectors against microservice architectures to harden defensive cloud posture without human intervention.
ideas.title: Self-Improving Cloud Security Red Teaming Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by implementing autonomous adversarial self-improvement loops similar to award-winning autonomous agent architectures.

ideas.pitch: A semantic search and query tool that lets cloud engineers retrieve live deployment states, database schemas, and metrics simply by chatting in natural language.
ideas.title: Natural Language Cloud Infrastructure Query Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets developer workflow friction with a live-demo-ready interface that highlights enterprise utility and efficient database integrations.
